propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through a single Pydantic Agent operation sharing an approved request budget with verified retry-contract tests for tool turns, output retries, and exhaustion.
Retry context must preserve complete failed responses when proven to fit, and omit them entirely otherwise, without truncating authoritative input, accepted output, or stored history.
Rebar must preserve deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal/filter behavior, typed exhaustion, final-failure artifacts, and answering-model provenance across the migration.
Successful operations must report Pydantic run usage exactly once, while fallback/downgrade candidates remain trace or journal events without competing usage counters.
The bespoke structured-output retry loop is removed only after the compatibility suite and Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries pass with live evidence.
All mode='structured' consumers (library/CLI/MCP/in-tree callers) must route through the single-operation facade with no out-of-scope parity gaps.
